sections.title: My Vibe Coding Workflow (Step by Step Workflow)

items.q: What should you remember about power-user stack (~12–16 hr/day)?
items.a: **$200/mo Claude**, OpenAI (GPT-5.5 via Codex), Cursor, Perplexity (research) — budget-flexible; not all required.

items.q: What should you remember about minimum vibe-coding trio?
What should you remember about monorepo-style parent folder with **separate project directories** (API, UI, MCP)?
items.a: **@-reference directories in prompts** so agents list and load the right files.

items.q: What should you remember about **Multiple workspaces** in BridgeSpace?
items.a: **e.g. BridgeMind + Vibe Academy** — with mixed agent fleets (4 Claude + 4 Codex).

items.q: What should you remember about cross-project references accelerate greenfield builds?
items.a: **"reference Vibe Academy API for Drizzle ORM pattern.".**

items.q: What should you remember about **Level 1** (button color, copy)?
What should you remember about **Level 5–6** (NestJS + Drizzle + Cognito + Discord auth)?
items.a: **plan mode, single strong** model (GPT-5.5 Extra High Fast for backend).

items.q: What should you remember about **Level 10** (full AWS VPC/ECR/ECS/RDS)?
items.a: plan mode + **five sub-agents**, Claude Code Extra High, AWS CLI profile on machine.

items.q: What should you remember about **UI design**?
items.a: Claude Opus 4.8; **backend**: GPT-5.5 Extra High; model routing by task type.

items.q: What should you remember about run **3+ agents in parallel** on non-overlapping scopes (API vs UI vs tests)?
items.a: **"if you only work** on one task, you're not a good vibe coder.".

items.q: What should you remember about track which agent owns which directory; merge conflicts rare when scopes differ.?
items.a: **Track which agent owns** which directory; merge conflicts rare when scopes differ.
